description: This file contains implementation of map manipulation functions for the Wesnoth game, including map resizing, flipping, flood fill, and tile retrieval.

methods.name: grow_and_pad
methods.description: Private helper function to grow or pad the map lines vertically or horizontally.

methods.name: get_tiles
methods.description: Returns a vector of locations within a given radius around a central point.

methods.name: flood_fill
methods.description: Fills an area starting from a location with a specified terrain, optionally logging the fill.

methods.name: get_component
methods.description: Returns all connected locations with the same terrain starting from a location.

methods.name: resize_map
methods.description: Resizes the map to new dimensions, filling new areas with a specified terrain.

methods.name: flip_map
methods.description: Flips the map along the specified axis (X or Y).

methods.name: valid_mapdata
methods.description: Checks if map data string can be parsed into a valid map.
